sessionStart.prompt: This repository may use the knowledge-folder convention (.arc42, .domain, .tech, .design, .backlog). Treat those folders as task-scoped context, not baseline context: load only the chapters the current task needs, never the whole folder by default. Every file and every addressable chapter in them carries a fenced `meta` block; when you create or edit one, write that block in the same change. Files under any _meta/ folder are generated - never hand-edit them, regenerate them instead.
